content: For small (10-15 player) turn-based party games, plain Socket.IO with an authoritative Node server is sufficient and standard; Colyseus/PartyKit add room/state-sync frameworks useful for real-time action games but are unnecessary overhead for a caption-and-vote game. 2026 default is WebSockets with authoritative server; PartyKit runs on Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects (edge, no self-hosted server needed); Colyseus is self-hosted or managed cloud ~5/mo.
